<!--
cea follows three rules: semantics before speed, evidence before claims, small
before large. A request that fits them is easier to accept. Please read
docs/design.md first.
-->

## The problem

What are you trying to find out or prove about a compiler or a program, and what stops you today? Describe the question, not only the feature.

## What you would like

The tool, option or provider you have in mind. If it is a new tool, say what input it takes, what it would record as observed and what as inferred, and what it could not see (its limitations).

## Which program would it run

If it needs a program that cea does not know yet (a compiler, a verifier, a reducer, a fuzzer), name it, say where to get it, and give its version command.

## Alternatives

What you do now, and other designs you considered.

## Additional context

Links, examples, test cases. Remove anything you cannot share.
